purpose: Structured camera/lens/lighting/composition/movement rules per scene-type and emotion, so image and video generation tools (Gemini, Meta AI, Kling, Runway) receive concrete direction instead of vague adjectives. Feeds camera_directions.md, image_prompts.md, and animation_directions.md directly.

scene_types.example_use: Child making dua, a quiet realization, a hug
scene_types.lighting: warm, soft key light, golden-hour tone
scene_types.composition: rule of thirds, character's eyes on the upper third line
scene_types.movement: slow push-in, or static — never a whip or fast pan here
scene_types.color_palette: Warm cream, soft gold, dusty rose — low saturation, high warmth
scene_types.depth_of_field: Shallow — soft-focused background, character in sharp focus

scene_types.example_use: Character first notices the problem (e.g. toy is missing)
scene_types.lens: 35mm equivalent (slightly wider, shows character + immediate environment)
scene_types.lighting: neutral daylight, slightly cooler than the resolution beat to signal mild tension
scene_types.composition: character slightly off-center, negative space toward whatever is causing the problem
scene_types.movement: static or very slow drift — stability keeps this from reading as scary, per DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.md's no-fear rule
scene_types.color_palette: Muted sage green, cool cream, soft grey undertones
scene_types.depth_of_field: Medium — background readable but not competing for attention

scene_types.example_use: Character actively searching, trying, or working at something
scene_types.composition: character in motion, rule of thirds with movement direction leading into open space
scene_types.movement: gentle tracking shot following the character's movement
scene_types.color_palette: Bright peach, warm mint, sunlit cream
scene_types.depth_of_field: Medium-deep — environment visible to show the search/effort in context

scene_types.example_use: Problem resolves, character relaxes, family reunites
scene_types.camera: medium-close, widening slightly from the conflict beat's close framing
scene_types.lighting: warm, golden, slightly brighter than the conflict beat
scene_types.composition: centered or rule-of-thirds, more open space around the character showing calm
scene_types.movement: slow pull-back or static — lets the moment breathe
scene_types.color_palette: Golden amber, warm cream, soft lavender
scene_types.depth_of_field: Shallow — mirrors the intimate_emotional_moment's focus pull inward

scene_types.example_use: Family together, dua said as a group, closing beat
scene_types.lighting: warm, even, soft — no harsh shadows
scene_types.composition: characters grouped closely, symmetrical or gently rule-of-thirds balanced
scene_types.movement: static — group stillness reinforces the calm-close pattern from ending_styles.json's family/dua endings
scene_types.color_palette: Full warm palette — cream, peach, sage, lavender balanced evenly
scene_types.depth_of_field: Deep — everyone and the room both in focus, nothing isolated

scene_types.example_use: The first 3-8 seconds of an episode or Short
scene_types.camera: close-up or extreme close-up on a single detail (an eye, a hand reaching, an empty spot where the toy should be)
scene_types.lighting: matches the scene's actual time of day, slightly higher contrast to grab attention
scene_types.composition: tight, off-center, deliberately incomplete (viewer wants to see more)
scene_types.movement: very slow push-in or static — the tightness itself creates the hook, not motion
scene_types.color_palette: High-contrast single accent color against neutral cream background
scene_types.depth_of_field: Very shallow — near-macro focus on the single detail

selection_rule: camera_directions.md and image_prompts.md select scene_type per beat by matching the beat's role (per STORY.md's 5 beats and emotion_database.json's emotion for that beat), then inline this file's camera/lens/lighting/composition/mood/movement fields directly into the self-contained prompt block — same 'inline, never reference' rule as image_prompts.md's locked character blocks.
